methodologyNotes: Eleven dutch ovens verified 2026-08-12 directly against manufacturer/DTC brand pages (Le Creuset, Made In, Great Jones, Our Place, Caraway, Xtrema, Overmont) and major retailer listings (Target, Amazon, Nordstrom) reached by live fetch; five seed items were dropped rather than guessed — Cuisinart (CI670-30) and Tramontina (6.5qt) because their sites returned unreachable/empty JS-rendered responses on every attempted URL and no independent retailer page could be confirmed in this pass; Marquette Castings because the brand's current catalog contains only a 4qt Dutch Oven (not 5.5qt as seeded) and its product page returned 404 on every fetch attempt despite being linked from the site's own homepage; Amazon Basics because Amazon blocks automated page fetches and no stable price/spec could be independently corroborated; and a previously-included 'Xtrema Versa Pot 5.5qt' entry was removed after re-verification because the Versa Pot product page (xtrema.com/products/versa-pot) offers only 1.5/2.5/3.5-quart sizes — the 5.5-quart is a separate 'Versa Stock Pot' SKU, so the 5.5qt Versa Pot as described did not exist at that URL. Xtrema is represented by its single genuine 'Round Dutch Oven' (10.5qt), and Overmont by two confirmed SKUs (5.5QT and 5QT enameled cast iron — the brand's current lineup does not include a 6qt size as seeded), both confirmed on their own sites. Xtrema and Our Place products are included as close category analogs even though their bodies are pure ceramic and ceramic-coated recycled aluminum respectively, not enameled cast iron; this is called out per-product in provenance. Fields left null (rather than estimated) where no fetched source stated a value: several diameters, weights, induction-compatibility claims (notably for solid-ceramic Xtrema, where induction compatibility is not manufacturer-confirmed one way or the other), and both Overmont prices (not published on the brand's own promotional site). accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout.

products.name: Le Creuset Signature Round Dutch Oven, 5.5 Qt.
products.priceNote: Nordstrom listing (specific colorway) at time of access; Le Creuset's own site displays a $285-$680 range spanning the full 2qt-13.75qt Signature Round size run, so exact price varies by size/color/retailer.

specs.interior_finish: Light-colored smooth interior enamel for easy monitoring of browning; dishwasher-safe, no seasoning required
specs.lid_handle_design: Tight-fitting lid engineered to circulate steam and self-baste; ergonomic stainless loop side handles; signature knob (Crucible knob on select colors)

Exact 5.5qt price ($455.00) and weight (11.4 lb, dims 11 x 13.9 x 6.9 in.) taken from Nordstrom's listing for this SKU, since Le Creuset's own page shows only an aggregate size range.

products.name: Staub Cast Iron 5.5-qt Round Cocotte
products.priceNote: Target listing (Basil colorway), sale price against $614.00 regular list; Staub direct-site connection failed repeatedly during this research pass, so Target is used as the verified retailer source.

specs.interior_finish: Black matte textured enamel interior for exceptional browning and food release; no seasoning required
specs.lid_handle_design: Heavy self-basting cast iron lid with interior spikes creating a continuous 'rain' basting effect; nickel-finish steel knob; cast iron side handles

products.provenance: Target's product listing states the bare pot is oven-safe to 900F/482C without the lid, while the lid itself is rated only to 500F/260C; 500 is used here as the practical whole-vessel figure for cross-brand comparability. Weight (14.22 lb) is Target's stated shipping weight and may include packaging; capacity, enamel finish, induction compatibility, and lid/handle design confirmed on the same listing.
